articles.title: Nitin Gadkari says a 100% ethanol car that doesn't need petrol will run as cheap as petrol priced at Rs 25 per litre
articles.description: Union minister Nitin Gadkari has said a car that runs entirely on ethanol, with no petrol needed at all, will launch in October. He said the running cost would work out equal to a petrol car using fuel priced at around Rs 25 a litre. Gadkari made the remarks while defending the government's ethanol blending policy and linking it to farmer income.

articles.title: Battered bonds draw support from falling oil prices

The dollar weakened against the yen but remained firm against the euro amid expected Fed rate hikes.

articles.title: Oil prices slide about 2% as US, Iran explore path out of war
articles.description: Oil prices have dropped roughly 2%, influenced by signs of diplomatic advancement between the US and Iran concerning the Strait of Hormuz. As negotiations unfold, the US is contemplating a ban on diesel exports, impacting crude oil futures. Meanwhile, escalating assaults by Houthi fighters are hindering oil supply from Saudi Arabia, while ongoing Russia-Ukraine discussions may further shake global energy markets.

articles.title: Dollar dips as oil eases, yen jumps on Japan remarks
articles.description: The dollar tumbled on Friday amidst softening oil prices, hinting at a cease to its prior gains. In contrast, the yen surged following Japan and the USs reassertion of their commitment to currency stability. Although oil prices linger above $100 a barrel, alleviating some inflationary pressures, Federal Reserve officials raised alarms over ongoing inflation, prompting expectations for more interest rate increases this year.
